<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<LinearLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    xmlns:app="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res-auto"
    android:layout_width="match_parent"
    android:layout_height="match_parent"
    android:orientation="vertical"
    android:background="#121212">

    <!-- Header -->
    <LinearLayout
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:orientation="horizontal"
        android:padding="16dp"
        android:gravity="center_vertical">

        <TextView
            android:id="@+id/btnBack"
            android:layout_width="wrap_content"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:text="←"
            android:textSize="24sp"
            android:textColor="#FFFFFF"
            android:padding="8dp"
            android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless"
            android:clickable="true"
            android:focusable="true" />

        <TextView
            android:layout_width="0dp"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:layout_weight="1"
            android:text="Избор на писта"
            android:textSize="24sp"
            android:textColor="#FFFFFF"
            android:textStyle="bold"
            android:gravity="center" />

    </LinearLayout>

    <!-- Create Custom Track Button -->
    <LinearLayout
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:orientation="vertical"
        android:paddingStart="16dp"
        android:paddingEnd="16dp"
        android:paddingBottom="8dp">

        <com.google.android.material.button.MaterialButton
            android:id="@+id/btnCreateCustom"
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="56dp"
            android:text="+ Създай Custom Писта"
            android:textSize="16sp"
            android:textStyle="bold"
            android:backgroundTint="#FF6B35"
            android:textColor="#FFFFFF" />

    </LinearLayout>

    <!-- Custom Tracks Section -->
    <LinearLayout
        android:id="@+id/llCustomTracksSection"
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:orientation="vertical"
        android:padding="16dp">

        <TextView
            android:layout_width="wrap_content"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:text="Custom писти"
            android:textSize="18sp"
            android:textColor="#FFFFFF"
            android:textStyle="bold"
            android:layout_marginBottom="8dp" />

        <androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView
            android:id="@+id/rvCustomTracks"
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content" />

        <TextView
            android:id="@+id/tvNoCustomTracks"
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:text="Няма създадена custom писта"
            android:textSize="16sp"
            android:textColor="#888888"
            android:gravity="center"
            android:padding="32dp"
            android:visibility="gone" />

    </LinearLayout>

    <!-- Official Tracks Section -->
    <LinearLayout
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:orientation="vertical"
        android:padding="16dp">

        <TextView
            android:layout_width="wrap_content"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:text="Официални писти"
            android:textSize="18sp"
            android:textColor="#FFFFFF"
            android:textStyle="bold"
            android:layout_marginBottom="8dp" />

        <androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView
            android:id="@+id/rvOfficialTracks"
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content" />

    </LinearLayout>

</LinearLayout>
